page.layout: One page of text in two columns of entries, with no margin notes. Running head at top centre; printed page number at top right. The handwritten "238" beside the page number is not printed text and is left out.

main_text.p: þing, à nocte venire conjecit Glossographus ibidem; quæ (inquit) olim Þitþ, non ut nunc (nigþt) scripta reperitur: Ita ut Þithing sit Lucifuga, &c. Fugit interim doctum virum vera vocis scriptura. Nox enim perperam apud Anglos scribitur, sive Þitþ sive Þigþt; rectè autem, & secundum Sax. scribendi modum, niht. Utut sit, luce clarius est, nihthing, cum Nequam notet, à Sax: niþe, nequitia, malitia, dimanasse.
Þewþ, Pravum] Quemadmodum hoc præcedenti, sic & huic affine nostrum naught, & naughtp, illo sensu, à niþe ortum.
Þorthalbon, Aquilonis] A Þorth, & halfe, eâpse apud Sax. significatione.
Þobanthog, Veruntamen] A superiori noban, & thog, Sax: Þeah, nobis though, tamen.
main_text.head: Verba:

page.notes: Anglo-Saxon words set in black letter; many letters are blurred and doubtful, especially in the entries from "Þewþ" on. Forms such as "Þitþ", "Þigþt", "nauhiebt" and "Þeruohlf" are best readings and may contain errors. The handwritten "238" is not transcribed. The bottom signature "Hh 2" is partly visible and is not transcribed as a signature here.
